# Control and Function

> SOC 2 readiness consulting for companies whose buyers have started asking for a report. Operator-led, fixed price, fully remote, Denver-based. Dual-framework engagements covering HIPAA, ISO 27001, and FERPA-driven buyer requirements.

## What we do

Control and Function is a compliance readiness practice. We prepare companies for their first SOC 2 audit and keep their compliance programs alive afterward. We also run dual-framework engagements when regulated buyers layer HIPAA, FERPA, or ISO 27001 obligations on top of SOC 2, mapping them into a single control set so clients build one program instead of three.

## Service offerings

- **SOC 2 Readiness Coaching** ($8K starting, 4 to 8 weeks): Office hours, document review, control guidance, and auditor liaison support while the client's team drives the work. Built for early-stage companies.
- **Full SOC 2 Readiness** ($15K starting, 12 to 16 weeks, fixed price): We drive the program end to end. Policies, control implementation, evidence collection, vendor reviews, pre-audit walkthrough, and a clean handoff to the audit firm.
- **Managed Compliance Retainer** ($1.5K to $4K per month): Evidence upkeep, control monitoring, vendor reviews, security questionnaire support, and Type II observation-window discipline between audits.
- **Dual Framework** (scoped individually): SOC 2 + HIPAA for healthcare buyers, SOC 2 + ISO 27001 for enterprise and international deals, and FERPA-aware programs for ed-tech companies selling into universities and K-12.

## Engagement timeline (Full Readiness)

Weeks 1 to 3: scope, system description, Trust Services Criteria gap assessment, Type I vs Type II sequencing. Weeks 4 to 7: policies and controls built. Weeks 8 to 12: evidence collected, remediation, vendor reviews. Weeks 13 to 16: audit firm referral, pre-audit walkthrough, auditor handoff.

## Our position

- We are a readiness and advisory firm ONLY. SOC 2 reports are issued by licensed CPA firms, and we are not one by design. We refer clients to audit firms for the audit itself and support them through the audit window. We never audit our own work.
- Operator credibility: we led a SOC 2 Type I program end to end with no outside MSP and no compliance platform, and it passed its audit clean on the first attempt.
- Platform-neutral: no referral fees from Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, or anyone else. We recommend a platform, or none, based on the client's environment.
- AI-accelerated delivery with human review on every artifact before it carries our name.
- Fully remote, no on-site work, no client network access. Fixed scope, fixed price.

## Who we work with

Companies without a dedicated compliance department, typically facing buyer security reviews, university or enterprise procurement questionnaires, or a contractual SOC 2 commitment.

## Client portal

Every engagement runs through a live client portal: control-by-control readiness across the Trust Services Criteria, a phase timeline with real dates, and a dated engagement log. The portal tracks evidence pointers only, never raw client artifacts, which remain in the client's environment.
